data.one_liner: Build custom UIs with accessible controls for showing and hiding content.
data.what_it_does: Provides accessible widgets like Disclosure, DisclosureGroup, and DisclosureTile to easily build expand/collapse UIs, accordion panels, and spoiler texts. It supports wrapper builders, custom triggers, and multi-panel groups.
use_when: You need accessible accordion panels or collapsible cards.
You are building nested menus or disclosure tiles.
You want custom layouts for showing and hiding content.
avoid_when: You are looking for full complete UI component kits rather than a specific disclosure widget.
You need non-UI state management logic.
strengths: Simplifies building accessible show/hide content controls.
Includes support for groups, tiles, and custom wrappers.
Supports theme customization and multiple layout configurations.
weaknesses: Limited to expand/collapse and disclosure functionality.
Not documented for platforms outside of standard Flutter targets.
